q_A: SELECT name , RESULT FROM battle WHERE bulgarian_commander != 'Boril'
gold_q_B: SELECT "battle"."name" AS "name", "battle"."result" AS "result" FROM "battle" AS "battle" WHERE "battle"."bg_cdr" <> 'Boril'

q_A: SELECT DISTINCT T1.id , T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.lost_in_battle WHERE T2.ship_type = 'Brig'
gold_q_B: SELECT DISTINCT "t1"."id" AS "id", "t1"."name" AS "name" FROM "battle" AS "t1" JOIN "ship" AS "t2" ON "t1"."id" = "t2"."lib" WHERE "t2"."ship_type" = 'Brig'

q_A: SELECT T1.id , T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id = T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed) > 10
gold_q_B: SELECT "t1"."id" AS "id", "t1"."name" AS "name" FROM "battle" AS "t1" JOIN "ship" AS "t2" ON "t1"."id" = "t2"."lib" JOIN "death" AS "t3" ON "t2"."id" = "t3"."caused_by_ship_id" GROUP BY "t1"."id" HAVING SUM("t3"."killed") > 10

q_A: SELECT name FROM battle WHERE bulgarian_commander = 'Kaloyan' AND latin_commander = 'Baldwin I'
gold_q_B: SELECT "battle"."name" AS "name" FROM "battle" AS "battle" WHERE "battle"."bg_cdr" = 'Kaloyan' AND "battle"."latin_cdr" = 'Baldwin I'

q_A: SELECT count(*) FROM battle WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT lost_in_battle FROM ship WHERE tonnage = '225' )
gold_q_B: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "_col_0" FROM "battle" AS "battle" WHERE NOT "battle"."id" IN (SELECT "ship"."lib" AS "lost_in_battle" FROM "ship" AS "ship" WHERE "ship"."tonnage" = '225')
